adjacent_literature_comparison.chemistry_boundary: CHF3/O2 on TiO2 with Cr mask; not the supplied CHF3/SF6/O2 condition and not machine-transferable
adjacent_literature_comparison.interpretation: The comparison rate clears the film in time, but the comparison selectivity exhausts 45 nm Cr before full clear.

adjacent_same_group_device_evidence.relationship: Same research group and TiO2 metasurface fabrication lineage; not demonstrated to use this exact recipe or layout.

blind_tio2_clearance_forecast.interpretation: The historical preregistered binary film-clearance call is preserved. It is not the current physics verdict after the wall-power correction and absorbed-power ensemble.

claim_class: target-free recipe arithmetic plus adjacent-experiment comparison; not an absolute-depth prediction

machine_family_self_bias_evidence.interpretation: Enables a deterministic machine-family sensitivity ensemble, not a unique target-condition voltage or depth prediction.

measured_molecular_collision_evidence.covered_pair_and_channels: CF3+ + CHF3 summed CID and summed DCT destruction
measured_molecular_collision_evidence.interpretation: Measured reactive destruction proves collisions are non-negligible; elastic/angular kernels and the remaining ion-neutral pairs are still unresolved.

measured_molecular_mobility_evidence.interpretation: Measured mass-resolved mobility closes a bulk/presheath momentum-relaxation scale, not an angular collision kernel or a target sheath IEAD.

necessary_conditions_for_full_clear.warning: Both gates are necessary. Practical mask survival needs selectivity above the zero-margin threshold.

next_discriminating_observations: achieved DC self-bias and, if available, RF voltage/current
blanket TiO2 removal and Cr loss or residual Cr
TiO2 phase/density and actual wafer-surface temperature
mask geometry, pitch, loading, chip/carrier size and position
scale-bearing SEM for the exact condition

physics_corrected_absorbed_power_envelop.interpretation: Current reactor-dose verdict: depth remains conditional on absorbed power, daughter-gas electron kinetics, the TiO2/Cr surface law, and feature transport.
